title: Measuring with cubes
examples: Teacher, which is longer, this block or that block?
Can we use cubes to see how long something is?
How do I know which one is shorter?

explain.say: Today we are going to learn about measuring things.
Some things are long, and some things are short.
We can use cubes to see how long something is.

items: Step 1: Place cubes end to end

explain.say: Look at this pencil. We can line up the cubes.
A big book is longer than a small crayon.
When we measure, we count how many cubes fit.

faq.q: How do I know if something is longer or shorter?
faq.a: You can compare two things right next to each other. If one goes further, it is longer.
asks: How do I tell which is longer?

faq.q: Do I always use cubes to measure things?
faq.a: No, you can use rulers or string too. Cubes are just one way to count the length.
asks: Is using cubes the only way?

faq.q: If I count the cubes, what am I finding?
faq.a: You are finding the length of the object in cubes. It tells you how many cubes fit.
asks: Am I measuring the weight or the length?

faq.q: If I put cubes on top of each other, is that measuring length?
faq.a: No, stacking cubes measures height. Length is how far it goes in a line.
asks: Can I measure height with cubes?

faq.q: Can I measure something curved with cubes?
faq.a: It is hard to measure curves perfectly with straight cubes. You might need a string for that.

facts: Longer means something covers more space in a line.
Shorter means something covers less space in a line.
Counting cubes helps us see the length by grouping.
We line up the cubes from one end to the other.

quiz.say: Which is longer: a pencil or a ruler?
quiz.why: The ruler is usually longer than a standard pencil.

wrong.0: This is tempting because pencils are things we use every day.
wrong.1: This is wrong because they are different objects with different sizes.
wrong.2: This is wrong because we can compare them by looking.

quiz.say: If I use 7 cubes to measure a worm, what am I saying?
quiz.why: Counting the cubes tells us the length by number.

wrong.0: The cubes measure the space it takes up, not its body parts.
wrong.1: Height is measured up and down, not along a line.
wrong.3: Cubes measure length, not how heavy something is.

quiz.say: If I see a very long train, and I use cubes, what must I do?

options.show: Line the cubes up end to end.
options.say: Line the cubes up end to end.

options.show: Put the cubes in a circle.
options.say: Put the cubes in a circle.

quiz.why: To measure length, you must place the cubes in a straight line.

wrong.0: Guessing is not measuring; we must count the cubes.
wrong.2: Stacking measures height, not the length of the train.
wrong.3: A circle shape does not show the straight length.
